title: M5GFX #436: LP I2C ACK-terminated read makes endTransaction wait 25 ms (code-level verification)

execution.environment: macOS arm64 read-only source inspection; no Arduino/ESP-IDF toolchain; local Device Service has 36 profiles without ESP32-C5; hardware test center has 5 nodes (4 online) without ESP32-C5

checks.detail: issue OPEN, 0 comments before handling, author GOB52, Japanese title/body; no m5agent reply exists
m5stack/M5GFX develop is 44324f34748812ce557e0dea39fb173cf9a73952, matching the 44324f3 reported by the author
src/lgfx/v1/platforms/common.hpp:275 declares readBytes(..., bool last_nack = false); Touch_CHSC6540.inl:73 and :78 both use the default, so the transaction ends with ACK

common.inl:2072 sets force_stop_read=false for LP ports, routing read termination into the controller STOP+END branch; :2099 waits i2c_stall_limit_us/1000 = 25 ms for TRANS_COMPLETE; :2110 calls i2c_stop() after the timeout
#423 cc60eaa only introduced force_stop_read; the STOP command and its 25 ms wait already existed for write termination and error paths. Reverting #423 would reintroduce #421
Touch_CHSC6540.inl:84 discards the endTransaction() return value with an empty if body, so connection_lost is invisible to the caller

CHSC6540 :73/:78, FT5x06 :118/:127 and CST816S :208/:213 all end with ACK; GT911 :150 reads the count with ACK and :158 reads coordinates with last_nack=true, so only its zero-point branch ends with ACK
proposal only: record whether the last read byte was ACK-terminated, then insert one READ+NACK before the LP STOP; not implemented, not compiled, not run on hardware
no duplicate issue and no open fix PR found in m5stack/M5GFX at handling time
no ESP32-C5 / ToughC5 hardware available; the 37-80 ms figures are the author's measurements, not reproduced here
local Device Service has 36 profiles and none is ESP32-C5; no C5 QEMU profile exists, so the reported board cannot be booted
no Arduino / ESP-IDF toolchain on this host; no minimal sketch or merged firmware was built
same common.inl path is shared by C6/P4 LP ports, but no corresponding touch configuration was available to confirm the same wait

notes: Issue left OPEN; exactly one Japanese reply posted (https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/issues/436#issuecomment-7005484763); no close, no push, no change to m5stack/M5GFX.
Evidence class is code-level verification. The author's hardware measurements are cited as their data, not reproduced.
